canvas.comment: The pack draws on a 512 wide grid whose diamonds are 292 tall. Every picture is bottom-aligned, with 152 pixels of earth under the front corner.

recolours.comment: A mown lawn: the same grass, a little greener and brighter.

swaps.comment: Colours taken from the pack: the rim drawn round the top of a grass tile, and the grass itself.

people.comment: Penzilla Giant NPC Sprite Pack. Each sheet is 8 frames by 5 rows. Row 1 faces south-west and row 3 north-west; the other two directions are mirrored. The first looks are the student crowd. The rest each have a job, named under roles: a role with two looks uses its number and the next.

credits.changes: Sprites are shrunk to the map scale and packed into one atlas. The drawn rim on the top edges of grass tiles is painted the colour of the grass, so tiles join. The lawn is a brightened grass tile. The gym is the plain hall with a dumbbell icon on its sign. The study center is the plain roofed shop with the open book from the Medieval pack on its signs. The outdoor court is cut from the tennis stadium. The first-aid icon is the pharmacy sign. Stadium tiers two and three add a second deck and a second stand made from the stand the stadium already has. Red crosses on the medical building, the health lab and the first-aid icon are recoloured green. Road pieces and cars are mirrored to face every way. The crossing is a road piece with its own lane mark enlarged and repeated across it. The recreation field is the soccer stadium with its stand, booth and banner cut away. For lit windows at night, the window glass of each apartment block is cut out on its own and recoloured a warm yellow. A club table, a picnic and a busker are the packs' own parasol, table, sign, banner, rug, basket, drum and lute stood together. The school banner among the decorations has its red cloth recoloured to each school colour. Founders' Commons is the packs' own grass, paving, statue, trees, street lamps, benches and flowers laid out together. A student's room is the Medieval stable's back corner taken apart into its two walls, on the city pack's concrete tile, with the packs' furniture and things; the Sport and Games icons in it are shrunk.
